title: SSC MCP operations and who the caller is
summary: SemanticSourceMcpOperations~dispatch(operation, request, principal) is the transport-neutral surface an MCP/HTTPS host calls after authenticating the caller. Implemented: source.import_archive_begin, source.import_archive_member, source.import_archive_resource, source.import_archive_complete, source.import_archive_fail, source.get_package, source.accept_revision, source.refuse_revision, source.accept_import, source.history, source.objects_in. No MCP host is wired to it yet.
invariants: The principal is the authenticated session's principal; any principal or imported_by claimed in the request body is replaced, never trusted.
Authentication is not authorization: acceptance is re-authorized per operation by the repository authorizer (Access Permissions in production).
Every reply is ok=1|0 with payload or error; nothing raises into the transport.
source.get_package returns files plus the exact revision manifest; with pins and project_id import:<id> it reproduces one import exactly.
Until a host registers these operations, live MCP SSC state is UNKNOWN, not available.
